name: Disconnect terminal block
summary: A disconnect terminal includes a documented separable path for circuit isolation or testing at the wiring level.
description: A disconnect terminal includes a documented separable path for circuit isolation or testing at the wiring level. Its reference operating state and terminal identity must be shown.
readingNotes: Identify the circuit path opened by the disconnect element.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A disconnect terminal is not automatically suitable for load interruption or for every CT testing arrangement.
